# proxmox_guest_proxy (Data Source)

Requests a guest console proxy (VNC, terminal or SPICE) through `/nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/{kind}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_proxy" "vnc" {
  type = "qemu"
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
  kind = "vncproxy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) `vncproxy`, `termproxy` or `spiceproxy`.
- `node` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `generate_password` (Boolean)
- `proxy` (String)
- `websocket` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `cert` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `port` (String)
- `result` (String)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `upid` (String)
- `user` (String)
